standard.summary: Bucket 训练的分辨率范围：max_bucket_reso 设置最大分辨率（超过的图像不会放入更大的桶而是缩小）；min_bucket_reso 设置最小分辨率（低于的图像按需放大或丢弃）。
standard.effect: 限制分辨率范围可以控制训练的显存使用上限（max）和确保训练分辨率不会过低（min）。
standard.whenToUse: max_bucket_reso 在数据集包含超高分辨率图像时防止 OOM；min_bucket_reso 在数据集包含低分辨率图像时避免无效训练。
standard.avoidWhen: 与 resolution（全局目标分辨率）重复设置时，max/min 是 bucket 分组的上下界，resolution 是理想桶面积目标，两者共同约束。

standard_en.summary: The resolution range for bucket training: max_bucket_reso sets the maximum resolution (an image above it is scaled down rather than placed in a larger bucket); min_bucket_reso sets the minimum (an image below it is scaled up as needed or dropped).
standard_en.effect: Limiting the range lets you cap the VRAM use of training (max) and make sure the training resolution never gets too low (min).
standard_en.whenToUse: max_bucket_reso prevents OOM when the dataset contains very high-resolution images; min_bucket_reso avoids wasted training when the dataset contains low-resolution ones.
standard_en.avoidWhen: They are not duplicates of resolution (the global target): max/min are the upper and lower bounds of bucket grouping while resolution is the ideal bucket area, and the two constrain things together.

advanced.principle: Bucket 算法在 [min_bucket_reso, max_bucket_reso] 范围内枚举所有可能的 bucket 尺寸，步长为 bucket_reso_steps。超出范围的图像会被缩放到范围边界最近的 bucket。
advanced.tradeoffs: max/min 设置过紧（范围太小）会导致大量图像被强制缩放（偏离原始比例），可能影响训练质量。

advanced_en.principle: The bucket algorithm enumerates all possible bucket sizes in [min_bucket_reso, max_bucket_reso] with step bucket_reso_steps. Images outside the range are scaled to the nearest in-range bucket.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Setting max/min too tightly (small range) forces many images to rescale (deviating from their original ratio), possibly hurting training quality.
